title: Create Sales and Category Tables with Sample Data

steps.content:
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sales', 'U') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE dbo.Sales;
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.Sales (
    SaleID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    ProductName NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    CategoryID INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES dbo.Category(CategoryID),
    Quantity INT NOT NULL,
    SaleDate DATE NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO dbo.Sales (ProductName, CategoryID, Quantity, SaleDate) VALUES
('Smartphone', 1, 10, '2024-06-01'),
('Laptop', 1, 5, '2024-06-02'),
('Novel Book', 2, 20, '2024-06-03'),
('T-Shirt', 3, 15, '2024-06-04');

SELECT s.SaleID, s.ProductName, c.CategoryName, s.Quantity, s.SaleDate
FROM dbo.Sales s
JOIN dbo.Category c ON s.CategoryID = c.CategoryID;
